leaves.heading: Annual privacy notice to customers required
leaves.text: Exception to annual privacy notice requirement —(1) When exception available. You are not required to deliver an annual privacy notice if you:
Provide nonpublic personal information to nonaffiliated third parties only in accordance with an exception; and
Have not changed your policies and practices with regard to disclosing nonpublic personal information.
If a revised privacy notice was required, you must provide an annual privacy notice.
If a revised privacy notice was not required, you must provide an annual privacy notice within 100 days.
